_**The Adapted Mind: Evolutionary Psychology and the Generation of Culture**_ is a 1992 book edited by the anthropologists [Jerome H. Barkow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerome_H._Barkow "Jerome H. Barkow") and [John Tooby](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Tooby "John Tooby") and the psychologist [Leda Cosmides](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leda_Cosmides "Leda Cosmides") . [[ 1 ]]()

First published by [Oxford University Press](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oxford_University_Press

...

The theoretical foundations of evolutionary psychology are discussed in the introduction, by Cosmides, Tooby and Barkow, in an essay by Tooby and Cosmides on "The Psychological Foundations of Culture", and an essay by anthropologist [Donald Symons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Symons "Donald Symons") "On the Use and Misuse of Darwinism in the Study of Human Behavior".
